subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw adopt third-party passive captures as a supported durable input, and which initial format, provenance, account-binding, completeness, and backup contracts should become permanent?
rationale: Current code has no generic import contract for these sources, while VISION.md requires durable attribution, completeness, backup, and CLI semantics for every new Twitter data surface.

options.title: Approve Scrollmark v1 first
options.body: Support only the versioned canonical bundle initially, with explicit provenance, partial-completeness, account-binding, backup, and ZIP-safety contracts.

options.title: Approve broad legacy support
options.body: Include heuristic Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter JSON or JSONL adapters immediately, accepting a larger unstable-format compatibility burden.

options.title: Defer capture imports
options.body: Retain official archives and live transports as the only supported ingestion sources until the third-party formats mature further.

recommendation.title: Approve Scrollmark v1 first
recommendation.body: Support only the versioned canonical bundle initially, with explicit provenance, partial-completeness, account-binding, backup, and ZIP-safety contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant product boundaries are defined in the repository vision, and the issue timeline shows @steipete directly engaging with this proposal.
